answer: A stranger with nothing to gain can confirm the proof before lunch. One honest proof costs 82 POA; one farm proof costs the same, but the farm needs 150 of them, which comes to 12300 POA. I would wager my own seat on Mortar mixer tessellated border assay laid upon the chapter hall, because its proof, each tessellated border is a mosaic record witnessed by the inspector, is public and checkable. One terrace is a pass, one plume is a fare, one pearl is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price.
